summary: Operator site + its own booking engine's site list: confirmed $29 (2026, +5.9% tax), 50-amp max, 24 pull-throughs, 40-ft max, store, online booking. Changed sites 29 -> 25 (25 RV sites; the other 4 are tent sites). Added water yes / sewer no, showers, wifi, no dump or laundry, deep link, deposit/refund terms. Note: dropped the field restatements, the rate and the RV Life line.
flags: Price gate: passes ($29 + 5.9% tax; no mandatory per-night fees). No gateway within 40 km (nearest Great Sand Dunes NP 228 km); not needed.
Presence: passes; own site with booking engine, phone (719) 691-1856 matches, email info@mapeslakeview.com.
Long-stay tests: pass. Nightly rate posted, booking engine sells every site nightly; monthly stays ($650) are a revocable license and the engine shows 1 of 29 sites reserved this week.
Booking engine offers no rig type at all (no motorhome/van choice); it lists every RV site to 40 ft, so EKKO fits.

Site data conflicts: the engine marks one pull-through as hasSewer, but the FAQ says 'We do not have sewer hookups on-site' (recorded false). Amenities says 'Most pull-through sites offer 50-amp', the engine lists 5 of 24 at 50 A. The pet fee is $2/pet/night on the amenities page but 'no extra charge' in the policies.
Water claim: the about text says 'the crystal-clear waters of Mapes Lake' and 'nestled on the shores'; it is boilerplate, and the reservoir is ~1.2 km south (not waterfront stands).
Season: no statement of operating dates; the engine takes January 2027 bookings. Left unset.
